data.name: Azleena
data.gender_notes: Azleena is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'azl' which means 'slender' and 'ilana' meaning 'radiant tree'. The name Azleena represents a woman who is slender and glowing, a beacon of light and beauty. The name Azleena carries the meaning “Slender, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azleena usually hope their child will grow to embody slender, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner radiance and strength, shining brightly for all to see.
data.etymology: Azleena belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Slender, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azleena total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

This name holds significant spiritual connotations, symbolizing perpetuity and infinity. The root etymology can be traced back to the Arabic concept of 'azal,' implying something that has no beginning or end.
